content.general_rule: A laboratory or an organisation is recognised by the Central Government; or (ii) recognised by a State Government
content.exception: content.exception = "in addition, a laboratory or an organisation established by or under any law for the time being in force, which is maintained, financed or aided by the Central Government or a State Government for carrying out analysis or test of any goods with a view to determining whether such goods suffer from any defect"
conditions: subject to such guidelines as may be issued by the Central Government in this behalf
